figures.title: FlashRNN2: separate recurrence from observation
figures.scope: Generic LSTM / sLSTM | FP16 / BF16 | inference forward | source-observed
figures.caption_zh: 选定基线是固定 0b84fc3 的 triton_fused 推理路径，二代是 SHA 绑定的泛型 persistent / PreparedSequence 实现。两侧都有融合时间循环、权重重用、FP32 内部状态及局部反馈；图不把这些一代能力归为二代首创。默认 full 模式保留逐步完整状态历史。二代的实际变化是可选的独立 FP32 compute carry、full/hidden/last 输出契约和 full-call 初始化上下文，使 chunk 继续执行不依赖低精度最后快照。局部 feedback 线只表示源程序依赖，不保证所有配置全寄存器驻留；布局与 spill 仍按配置核实。独立预取 overlap 是 Proposed，C_t 是训练专用缓存，在两侧选定推理路径中均不分配。
figures.caption_en: The pinned triton_fused inference baseline (0b84fc3) and the SHA-bound generic FlashRNN2 path both fuse the timestep loop, reuse recurrent weights, retain FP32 computation state and feed state locally. These are inherited mechanisms. Full history remains the default on both sides. The implemented delta is the opt-in separation of FP32 computation carry from observable snapshots, explicit full/hidden/last output modes, and full-call initialization context. This permits chunk continuation without using a rounded final snapshot. Local feedback denotes source-level dependence, not a claim that every shape is entirely register resident. Independent-prefetch overlap remains Proposed; C_t is backward-only and absent from the selected inference paths.
figures.alt_zh: 左右同构机制图：R/b 进入 MMA，预投影 U_t 进入状态更新；S_t 在局部反馈，同时写出 Y_t。左侧最后状态是快照视图，右侧可选择独立 FP32 chunk carry。下方标明继承的局部性、真实新增契约和候选重叠。
figures.alt_en: Two homologous panels show R/b feeding recurrent MMA, U_t feeding state update, local S_t feedback and separate Y_t writes. The baseline exposes a final snapshot view; FlashRNN2 can expose independent FP32 chunk carry. Notes distinguish inheritance, implemented changes and proposed overlap.
figures.takeaway_zh: 局部反馈是所选基线的已有机制；二代将输出快照与继续递归所需的 carry 分开。

figures.title: State residency: scope, storage and lifetime
figures.scope: Generic MMA path | one CTA / batch tile / head | exact object allocation: TBD
figures.caption_zh: 上半图将执行范围与物理存储区分：CTA 是 batch/head 工作的拥有者，不代表独占 SM；代表 H100 PTX 已见寄存器 MMA fragments、共享内存 ldmatrix 交换和 CTA barrier。源程序 S_t、R/b、A_t 的全形状物理分配仍为 Unknown，不能由 loop-carried SSA 推断全寄存器、无 spill。global backing、逐步必需输出和 chunk carry 是独立对象。下半生命周期按 init、t、t+1、finish 说明读取、消费与复用；R/b 在一个 chunk 的循环中重用，下个 kernel 重新加载；FP32 carry 跨 chunk 写入并供下个顺序 kernel 使用。没有把双 carry 缓冲画成异步 input staging。输出遵守 full/hidden/last 模式，PreparedSequence 的借用结果需在下一次覆盖前消费。C_t 在当前推理范围不分配。
figures.caption_en: The upper panel separates a CTA execution scope from physical storage. Representative H100 PTX confirms register MMA fragments, shared-memory ldmatrix exchange and CTA barriers; it does not establish a universal S_t/R/b/A_t allocation or zero spills. Global backing, required output history and boundary carry are separate objects. The lifetime strip covers init, t, t+1 and finish: R/b are reused inside a chunk and reloaded by a later kernel, while independent FP32 carry is exported at a boundary and read by the next serial chunk. Two carry arrays are not an asynchronous input-staging pipeline. Output lifetime follows full/hidden/last and the prepared borrowed-buffer contract. C_t is absent in this inference scope.
figures.alt_zh: CTA 范围内显示寄存器 fragments、shared exchange 和计算资源；global 区显示权重 backing、输入和输出/carry。下方六条生命周期说明状态消费、输入 ready、accumulator 消费及输出写出，标明未知的完整物理布局。
figures.alt_en: A CTA scope contains register fragments, shared exchange and compute resources, with global weights, inputs and outputs below. Six lifetime rows identify load, ready, consume, carry and output boundaries. Full physical object mapping is explicitly TBD.
figures.takeaway_zh: 常驻描述的是源程序在 chunk 内的重用；物理布局、spill、输出寿命和跨 chunk carry 分别有边界。

figures.title: Dependency-aware execution: preserve recurrent order
figures.scope: Logical execution order - not to scale; no measured overlap or speedup implied
figures.caption_zh: 主面板将同一条 recurrence 展开成三个 timestep。源码中 MMA 结果与当前 U_t 都要就绪才能更新 S_t；required Y_t store 与更新同属实际执行路径。h_t 的下一步转换以及 compiler layout/visibility 在下一 MMA 前发生，c/n/m 也为下一 update 保留；图不将相邻完整 MMA 任意并行。时序是源码依赖的 logical schedule，未用微秒、cycle 或柱宽暗示实测速度；compiled 内部交换可随配置而变。C_t 在该推理范围不分配。下方独立 Proposed 面板只展示已知 U_(t+1) 的候选预取：issue、ready、consumer complete、reusable。输入与状态均 ready 才能消费，所有 consumer 完成后才可复用，协议和独立资源仍 Unknown。两个 FP32 chunk carry 缓冲遵守同一 stream 的顺序消费，不能当成异步重叠的证明。
figures.caption_en: Three unrolled timesteps preserve the same-recurrence dependency. Both A_t and U_t must be available before state update; required Y_t stores share the actual execution path. The next hidden operand is cast and made visible before recurrent MMA, while c/n/m remain dependencies of the next update. Adjacent full recurrent MMAs are not arbitrarily parallel. This is a source-derived logical schedule, not a measured timeline; compiler layout/exchange may vary. C_t is absent from inference. The separate Proposed panel gives only a legal independent U_(t+1) prefetch lifecycle: issue, ready, consumer complete, reusable. Consumption requires input and state readiness; reuse waits for every consumer. Protocol and independent resources are TBD. Sequential chunk carry buffers do not prove overlap.
figures.alt_zh: 四条泳道按三个 timestep 展示 MMA、输入装入、更新与输出、状态转换/ready。紫色连线保留下一 MMA 与下一 update 的依赖。下方虚线候选条带展示输入 issue、ready、consume、reuse，不带时间单位。
figures.alt_en: Four logical lanes show MMA, input load, update with required stores, and cast/state-ready over three timesteps. Purple edges retain next-MMA and next-update dependencies. A separate dashed candidate strip shows issue, ready, consume and reuse without measured time units.
figures.takeaway_zh: 可重叠的是独立工作；同一 recurrence 的 MMA 必须等待所依赖的 state ready，buffer 复用必须晚于消费。

label: (b) Independent input prefetch: PROPOSED overlap window

figures.title: Explicit execution planning and supported paths
figures.scope: Generic forward | exact-shape offline policy | caller passes config to PreparedSequence
figures.caption_zh: 上半图是当前 ExecutionPolicy 的真实 exact-shape 分派：非空离线表须匹配执行 identity，key 包含 cell、dtype、B/T/H/D；未命中的合法请求使用既有 MMA16/4/B，而 identity 错误明确报错。MMA 和 SIMT 的资格需来自固定数值门槛与离线表，图中不猜 batch 阈值。下半图是调用者显式传入 config 的 PreparedSequence：shape、dtype、contiguity、单 CUDA device、forward-only、output mode、chunk sum 等检查通过后选择实际 MMA/SIMT kernel 并保留对应 Y/carry 契约。非法请求没有自动转往一代所有 backends。资源可行性由编译/启动限定，当前没有 runtime budget 查询或完整自动 fallback registry；下方能力/资源感知策略以及 cluster/WGMMA/FP8 均为 Proposed。该图表示实验调用者和组件的实际连接，不声称公开 API 内置自动调优。
figures.caption_en: The upper panel shows the implemented exact-shape ExecutionPolicy: nonempty offline tables require matching execution identity, keys contain cell/dtype/B/T/H/D, a missing key uses existing MMA16/4/B, and identity mismatch raises an error. No batch threshold is invented. The lower panel shows explicit caller-supplied configuration entering PreparedSequence. Shape, dtype, contiguity, one CUDA device, forward-only semantics, output mode and chunk checks precede the selected MMA/SIMT kernel and the preserved Y/carry contract. Invalid requests do not automatically switch to all upstream backends. Compiled resources constrain feasibility; there is no current runtime-budget query or complete automatic-fallback registry. Capability/resource-aware dispatch and cluster/WGMMA/FP8 remain Proposed. The connection is the experiment caller, not a request-time autotuner built into the public API.
figures.alt_zh: 上方 exact-shape 表将匹配请求送往 table config，未命中送往默认 MMA，身份错误送往 error。调用者将 config 交给下方 PreparedSequence，经语义与布局验证后运行 MMA/SIMT 并返回输出和carry。未知资源门槛与后续策略用独立 TBD/Proposed 框表示。
figures.alt_en: An exact-shape table branches to measured configuration, conservative MMA default, or identity error. The caller passes configuration to a separate prepared-execution panel, which validates inputs, launches MMA/SIMT and returns output/carry. Unknown resource limits and future policy extensions are isolated and labeled.
figures.takeaway_zh: 实际 selector 是离线 exact-shape 表与保守 MMA fallback；更广的能力/资源/后端自动选择仍是候选。
